corrections.reason: The word wraps onto L06 as 'እኒህን' ('these enemies of mine'). Visually on L05 the character is 'ኒ' (3rd order with a short horizontal foot on the right), not 'ኔ' (5th order ring).
Cross-reference to Mark 11:1 ('ማር ፲፩ ፩ ።'). Looking closely at Col 1 L16, after 'ማር' is '፲፩' (11) followed by '፩' (1).
Classical Ge'ez gerundive 'ወሐዊሮሙ' (and having gone) takes 1st order 'ሐ', not 7th order 'ሖ'.
